audit_scope: Static review of cursor native preparation/dispatch guards, current policy, dedicated copied flow, current guard-test receipt, and cursor-method notes. No preparation, preflight, Vivado/native invocation, or timing inference.

gate_state_at_review.eligibility: NOT_ELIGIBLE_YET: actual Default is still RUNNING and full canonical cursor composition is not yet present; both must pass their required terminal gates before preparation. A positive Default result requires the global positive repeat first.

guard_tests.actual_full_canonical_parent: R5 PREFIX; canonical raw/artifact closure validated by pure helper
guard_tests.mocks: Terminal Default and positive-cursor-parent cases are explicit synthetic fixtures; temporary ledger cases exercise the budget guard.

review_findings.source_binding: Preparation binds actual focus summary and canonical-cursors receipt; requires exactly 18 ordered aliases (17 SV plus header), exact Q source/artifact closure, only the scratch alias differing from PREFIX, and exact cursor focus/proof/adapter hash closure. Dispatch rechecks preflight, policy, helper, flow, contract, source snapshots, recipes, and parent checkpoint pins.
review_findings.observability: Contract preserves exact public outputs including invalid values/counters/debug/memory, exact live cursor state when either implementation has an active owner, and intentionally allows retired private cursor payload divergence. Explicit all_private_state_exact=false and zero public latency delta are propagated.
review_findings.runtime_method: Fresh RTL only; actual RuntimeOptimized synth_design directive required. The guard uses case-insensitive matching for the observed log token, consistent with the actual R5 log value `runtimeoptimized`; no checkpoint clock inheritance or retiming is admitted.
review_findings.default_and_repeat: Default is terminal eligibility evidence only and cannot become the source/method baseline. Active or positive Default rejects cursor preparation. One initial cursor trial and at most one global positive fresh repeat across native/default/cursors; repeat requires a positive completed cursor parent and fresh RTL.
review_findings.flow: Dedicated flow keeps synth_design RuntimeOptimized; only run.tcl metadata differs from ready flow. report.tcl and component.xdc are byte-identical. Opt Default, place ExtraNetDelay_high, phys opt disabled, route Default; no clock/XDC exception.
review_findings.resources: Runner constrains memory and swap to 8 GiB, CPU/thread count to 2, wall timeout to 2400 s, requires host available memory >=8 GiB and PSI full avg10 <1 at start, stops below 4 GiB or after two pressure samples >=5, and checks active heavy-job cap.
review_findings.guard_test_limit: 48 validator tests (17 accepted / 31 rejected) are not a Vivado/native run and do not qualify an actual terminal Default result or successful cursor timing.

decision: Code and safeguards are coherent for a later gated preflight. Do not prepare/launch now: current Default receipt is RUNNING and the composed full-Q cursor result is absent. No preflight PASS is issued.
